name: BigSmile: The Message
source:
After the disturbing events of KryptoUwU’s final livestream, one viewer refuses to move on. Obsessed with revenge, she teams up with an old friend—an experienced hacker—to hunt down the man responsible.

Their investigation leads them to a hidden place buried deep within the Shadow Web.
What begins as a search for justice quickly turns into a descent into cruelty, voyeurism, and madness.

Once the door is opened, there is no turning back.
And not everyone will come out the same.

[From [url=https://ramose-tsimbina.itch.io/bigsmile-the-message]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在KryptoUwU最后一次直播发生令人不安的事件后，一名观众拒绝继续观看。痴迷于复仇的她与一位老朋友（一位经验丰富的黑客）联手追捕肇事者。

他们的调查将他们带到了暗影网深处的一个隐藏地点。
一开始寻求正义很快就变成了残忍、偷窥和疯狂。

门一旦打开，就没有回头路了。
并不是每个人都会得到同样的结果。

[来自[url=https://ramose-tsimbina.itch.io/bigsmile-the-message]itch.io[/url]]
